Current State: Privacy responsibilities exist but ownership is not fully documented
Gap Identified: Privacy accountability is not formally assigned across key processing activities
Business Impact: Unclear ownership may delay compliance decisions or remediation
Recommended Remediation: Assign documented privacy owners and create a privacy governance responsibility matrix

Current State: A partial data inventory exists but several systems are missing
Gap Identified: The organization does not maintain a complete inventory of personal data processing
Business Impact: Unknown data flows may create unmanaged privacy and compliance risk
Recommended Remediation: Complete the personal data inventory and assign owners for each processing activity

Gap Identified: A complete and maintained ROPA does not exist
Business Impact: The organization may be unable to demonstrate accountability or understand processing activities
Recommended Remediation: Create and maintain a formal Records of Processing Activities register

Current State: Lawful basis is known for major processes but is not centrally documented
Gap Identified: The lawful basis for every processing activity is not consistently recorded
Business Impact: Personal data may be processed without sufficient documentation of legal justification
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized lawful basis register and link each processing activity to its justification

Current State: Consent is captured for marketing but withdrawal evidence is inconsistent
Gap Identified: Consent and withdrawal activity is not consistently traceable
Business Impact: Individuals may continue receiving processing after withdrawing consent
Recommended Remediation: Centralize consent records and retain evidence of withdrawal processing

Current State: Some forms collect optional data that may not be necessary
Gap Identified: Personal data collection exceeds the minimum required for some processing activities
Business Impact: Unnecessary personal data increases breach impact and compliance exposure
Recommended Remediation: Review collection forms remove unnecessary fields and document justification for retained fields

Current State: Retention practices exist but periods are not consistently documented
Gap Identified: A formal enterprise data retention schedule is incomplete
Business Impact: Personal data may be retained longer than necessary
Recommended Remediation: Create a formal retention schedule with owners deletion triggers and secure deletion evidence

Current State: Request procedures exist but tracking is partly manual
Gap Identified: DSAR intake identity verification deadlines and closure are not centrally tracked
Business Impact: Requests may be delayed or handled inconsistently
Recommended Remediation: Implement centralized DSAR tracking with deadline alerts and closure evidence

Current State: Deletion procedures exist but cross-system verification is incomplete
Gap Identified: The organization cannot consistently prove that personal data was deleted across all applicable systems
Business Impact: Personal data may remain after a valid deletion request
Recommended Remediation: Implement end-to-end deletion verification and retain evidence from affected systems

Current State: Processor reviews occur but recurring reassessment is inconsistent
Gap Identified: High-risk processors are not consistently reassessed
Business Impact: Third-party processing weaknesses may expose personal data or create compliance violations
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual privacy and security reassessments of high-risk processors

Current State: Most processors have DPAs but evidence is incomplete for some vendors
Gap Identified: Some applicable processors do not have complete DPA documentation
Business Impact: Contractual privacy obligations may be missing or unclear
Recommended Remediation: Track DPA status for all processors and obtain missing agreements

Current State: International transfers exist but safeguard documentation is incomplete
Gap Identified: Transfer mechanisms and supporting risk assessments are not consistently documented
Business Impact: Personal data may be transferred without sufficient safeguards
Recommended Remediation: Document transfer mechanisms complete transfer impact reviews and retain approval evidence

Current State: A breach process exists but privacy-specific exercises are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Privacy breach notification procedures have not been regularly tested
Business Impact: Notification decisions may be delayed during a personal data breach
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual privacy breach tabletop exercises and document escalation and notification decisions

Current State: DPIAs are performed for some projects but triggers are not consistently documented
Gap Identified: High-risk processing may begin without a documented DPIA review
Business Impact: Privacy risks may not be identified before new processing is introduced
Recommended Remediation: Define DPIA triggers and require documented assessment before high-risk processing

Current State: Compliance evidence exists across multiple locations
Gap Identified: Privacy compliance evidence is fragmented and difficult to retrieve
Business Impact: The organization may struggle to demonstrate compliance during audits or investigations
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized privacy compliance evidence repository and recurring review process
